all the Abbott molecular, antigen and serologic assays detect the three variants.

the Abbott ID NOW, BinaxNOW, and Panbio antigen tests are effective in detecting the B.1.617 variant of concern, and that Abbott molecular tests are effective in identifying this and other variants of concern.
